title: Longest Unique Stretch
statementMd:
Find the length of the **longest substring with no repeated characters**. Grow a window to the right; when a character repeats, jump the window's left edge past its previous position. Remember each character's last index.

**Input**
One word of lowercase letters (1–10⁵ characters).

**Output**
The length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
hints: Keep left (start of the window) and last[c] = the most recent index of character c.
If c was last seen INSIDE the window (last[c] >= left), move left to last[c] + 1 — never move it backwards.
